Lin: Heads-up — token tail latency spike in prod after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Not huge QPS change but p99 tokens up ~18ms on some routes. https://redwood.app/d/metrics/perf?panel=token_breakdown :eyes:
Mia: I see it on the per-route view. SM occupancy +8–12% on A100s for small-batch routes (seq_len <= 128). VRAM baseline up ~2.3GB during steady traffic windows.
Oliver: I added a quick panel for token-level latency breakdown (kv vs kernel vs queue). Query I used: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))` — shows kernel_exec dominating tail now.
Raj: KV cache hit-rate dipped ~6% around 02:12 UTC correlating w/ the latency bump. Logs show increased workspace allocations around same time — could be eviction pressure.
Lin: My suspicion: selector is choosing a fused/large-kernel variant for the short-seq path (selector threshold change). That kernel has higher shared memory usage -> higher SM occupancy on those MIG slices. On 1g.5 MIGs this pushes power/thermal up and reduces concurrency.
Henry: Uploaded profiler snapshot and a small flamegraph: /internal/perf/1793012345/profile-heap.html. Capture command I ran: `PYTORCH_NVTX=1 python -m runtime.profile --trace --out /tmp/pf.json`. Flamegraph shows a longer tail in `attention_fused_forward` for affected slices.
devops-bot: Canary deploy v2.14 -> nodes: 12/36. Canary started at 1793011320. Monitoring enabled: perf, kv, gpu-telemetry.
Mia: Proposal: add per-route token waterfall panels that explicitly show `kv_lookup_ms`, `kernel_exec_ms`, `queue_wait_ms`. Also a small panel to show workspace_alloc_bytes by model+kernel to detect sudden growth. I can make the Grafana panels and dashboard rows.
Oliver: Add an alert: sustained avg GPU power > 300W for > 5m OR SM occupancy > 75% for > 10m on a pod -> page oncall. That would catch capacity saturation on MIG slices.
Lin: Quick triage plan:
- Mia: add waterfall panels + workspace_alloc heatmap (ETA: 2h).
- Henry: run deterministic replay with profiler flags to capture workspace sizes and kernel selection logs (ETA: 3h).
- Raj: run KV cache sim on staging to reproduce 6% hit-rate drop with increased workspace eviction (ETA: 4h).
- Oliver: add the GPU power/SM alerts and link to incident runbook.
If regression persists on canary after 1h, rollback kernel-selector change. @devops-bot please keep canary pinned. :thumbsup:
Mia: noted, assigning dashboard task now. Will post panel links when ready.
Henry: will attach the replay artifacts here once done (trace + `nvprof`/cupy profile).
Lin: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single place for updates. If anyone see related anomalies on other clusters please mention here.
